heading.en: A crowded kitchen, a quiet hero

body.en: Sophie lives with her parents and two brothers in a modest home. Her father is a hard-working, short-tempered man who has little patience with her stories; her mother is tired and anxious. Her younger brother Derek is a child, while her elder *brother Geoff* is a quiet young man who works as an apprentice mechanic.

body.en: *Geoff* is the only person Sophie really confides in. Because he is silent about his own life, she imagines a wider, exciting world behind his silence and longs to be part of it. She feels that if she could share his world, she too would be going places.

problem.en: Why did Sophie admire her brother Geoff?

steps.en: Note that Geoff was older and worked in the city as an apprentice mechanic.
Explain that his silence made his life seem mysterious.
Link it to her wish to escape: she wanted to share his wider world.

answer.en: Geoff was older, worked as an apprentice mechanic and travelled to work. He rarely spoke about his life, so Sophie imagined it as exciting and grown-up. She longed to be part of his world, which seemed a way out of her dull home.
